# Draftava 1.3.14
This update improves protection and recovery of drafts when iCloud synchronization encounters conflicting project versions.
- Stops unsafe automatic conflict resolution based on computer identity or timestamps. - Preserves device-local recovery copies before shared saves. - Shows blocked-save status and performs guarded background inspection. - Adds non-destructive recovery bundles and reconciliation reports. - Allows preserved journal drafts to be exported or recovered as copies. - Retains original conflict evidence for manual investigation.
Cross-Mac conflict handling is still undergoing validation. Divergent histories are not automatically merged.
